description: FULL BODY head to toe. A Malaysian man in his late 30s. He wears a crisp, dark blue Royal Malaysia Police (PDRM) uniform with silver buttons, official badges on the chest, and a matching peaked cap. He has a clean-cut appearance with short black hair and a stern but professional expression.

FULL BODY head to toe. A Malaysian man in his late 60s. He has thinning grey hair and a weathered face. He is wearing a traditional light-colored baju melayu top with dark trousers and simple sandals. He has a look of concern and vulnerability.

FULL BODY head to toe. A featureless, anonymous human silhouette. The figure is entirely pitch black and shadowy with no visible facial features. The silhouette is shaped like a person wearing a bulky tactical vest to distinguish it from other scammers.

FULL BODY head to toe. A featureless, anonymous human figure. The figure has a smooth, glowing blue digital circuit pattern across its entire body, resembling an AI robot or a holographic projection, with no face or hair.
